sections.name: Verse 1
lines: As pants the hart for cooling streams
So longs my soul, O God, for Thee,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: For Thee, my God, the living God,
O when shall I behold Thy face,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Hope still, and thou shalt sing
The praise of Him who is thy God,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: To Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
Be glory, as it was, is now,
